bagPolicy.summary: The NFL Clear Bag Policy is enforced at M&T Bank Stadium to enhance safety and expedite entry. Only specific clear bags and small clutches are allowed.
allowed: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags not exceeding 12" x 6" x 12"
Small clutch bags/belt bags not exceeding 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: Purses larger than a clutch bag
Seat cushions with a back, pocket, or zipper
bagPolicy.note: Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection.

parking.note: Parking for Ravens games is sold out to permit holders, with non-disabled parking typically sold in advance. Disabled parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis in Lots B, C & R. Consider using public transportation or downtown parking options.

rideshare.note: These directions are not designated rideshare pick up locations. They are suggested areas for guests to be able to possibly pick up a rideshare provider.

concessions.note: The Flock Friendly Fare menu at M&T Bank Stadium offers 11 fan-favorite items priced under $5, including new additions like Blackbird Chips and a BBQ Chicken Sandwich. These budget-friendly options are available stadium-wide, ensuring fans have convenient access to concessions.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by M&T Bank Stadium, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in M&T Bank Stadium's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: M&T Bank Stadium Box Office Hours of Operation: Mon-Fri 9:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. (available for phone calls on Saturday prior to Sunday home games from 10:00 a.m. - 2:00 p.m.) On Gamedays when the team is at home, the main ticket office is located by SeatGeek Gate F.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at M&T Bank Stadium. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
